about: The Sea Swings, designed in park px. A point (X, Y, z) round the ride's axis (X right, Y towards the viewer, z up, all park px) is drawn at screen (hub.x + X, hub.y + k(z) Y - z) with k(z) = k0 - kz z: ground circles are ellipses 0.39 as tall as wide (the east carousel's floor, measured), flattening a little with height as the painting's roofs do. phi = 90 degrees is the front (lowest on screen). Heights z are above the deck.

painted.about: The painted canopy and column as the takes draw them, park px, with the canopy at full lift (gen/ride_v1_0.png: band, cone, cupola, finial) and the column (gen/ride_v1_1.png). Ellipses {c, a, b}; fitted with tools/fit_canopy.py and gridded zooms (tools/zoom_grid.py).

about_motion: Chains hang from a ring of radius canopy.hang under the crown band, at z hang_z when the canopy is lifted (as painted in gen/ride_v1_0.png) and hang_z - lift at rest; chain is the chain length to the chair's rings (at the top of the chair). At rest the rings hang at z rest - chain = 33, the chairs' footrests (17.4 px below the rings) 1.6 px over the platform floor (z 14).
